explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Safavid conquest of Shirvan" (revision 1375207686) says: "Ismail's victory alarmed the ruler of the Aq Qoyunlu, Alvand, who subsequently proceeded north from Tabriz, and crossed the Aras River in order to challenge the Safavid forces; a pitched battle was fought at Sharur in which Ismail's army came out victorious despite being outnumbered by four to one." The edge reads that sentence as: Safavid conquest of Shirvan caused Battle of Sharur, and nothing more.
